display.purpose: Hero headlines, page titles. One or two per viewport.

components.name: Primary Button (Action CTA)
components.description: The primary call-to-action. Amber-orange on white/blue backgrounds. Use for Submit, Send, Browse, Contact.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e8590c; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 28px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 150ms, transform 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d9480f; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action. White with blue border. Use for Contact Us, View All.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #2563eb; padding: 12px 28px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 2px solid #2563eb; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eff6ff; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Product display card with image zoom on hover. 8px radius, shadow appears on hover.
components.html:
Gate Valve DN50

PN16 · Cast Iron
components.css: .ds-card-product { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 300ms; } .ds-card-product:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-card-image { aspect-ratio: 1; background: #f3f4f6; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-card-product:hover .ds-card-image img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: #111827; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Pearl border, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; color: #111827; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #3b82f6; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Neutral filter/tag chip. Full radius, Frost background.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; background: #f3f4f6; color: #4b5563; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: Blue accent badge for active categories and product category labels.
components.css: .ds-chip-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; background: #eff6ff; color: #2563eb; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Recurring section opening motif: title + blue accent bar + spacing.
components.css: .ds-section-title { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); font-weight: 700; color: #111827; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-section-bar { width: 64px; height: 2px; background: #2563eb; margin-bottom: 24px; }

narrative.overview:
PLOVER's digital presence reads like a carefully curated industrial showroom — a space where technical precision meets the confidence of a manufacturer who knows their product speaks for itself. The palette is deliberately restrained: cool blues establish trust and structure, while a single warm accent (industrial amber-orange) punctuates the moments that matter — the CTAs, the inquiry buttons, the actions that move a deal forward.

Density leans comfortable-to-open. Products breathe in generous grids. Typography is system-native and confident, relying on weight and scale rather than decorative typefaces to create hierarchy. Every surface is flat at rest; depth appears only as a response to interaction — a card lifts on hover, a dropdown reveals its shadow, a modal dims the world behind it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm/cool contrast — blue for trust and information, amber-orange for action and urgency
Gallery-grade whitespace — products displayed with the breathing room of a physical showroom
Restrained depth — flat-by-default surfaces; shadows only as state feedback
System-native typography — no custom fonts; hierarchy through weight, scale, and spacing
Industrial B2B voice — confident, technical, unflashy; credibility over cleverness

rules.name: The Warm Action Rule
rules.body: Amber-orange appears only on interactive elements that trigger a submission, navigation, or inquiry. It never decorates, never appears in body text, never fills a surface larger than a button.

rules.name: The Blue Rest Rule
rules.body: Industrial Blue is never used as a surface fill (except the hero gradient). It lives on text, borders, and small indicators. A blue background is a bug, not a feature.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: The system uses only three weights: 400 (body), 500 (labels/captions), and 600-700 (headlines). No light weights, no black weights.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If an element has a shadow at rest, it needs justification. Shadows are earned through interaction (hover) or elevation (modals), not assigned arbitrarily.

dos: Do use amber-orange (#e8590c) exclusively for primary CTAs — Submit, Send, Browse, Contact
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; reserve shadows for hover and elevation states
Do use the blue accent bar (64px x 2px) consistently beneath section headings
Do let product images be the hero — give them generous aspect ratios and clean backgrounds
Do use the system font stack; never introduce decorative typefaces for body or UI text
donts: Don't use Industrial Blue as a surface fill color (except the hero gradient)
Don't use amber-orange for anything that isn't a clickable action
Don't add shadows to elements at rest
Don't use more than one accent color per screen
Don't break the section header pattern — every content section opens with title + blue bar + spacing
